title: Banging Plant-Based Patty Chip Butty
subtitle: with Tangy Coleslaw
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Roast chips: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potato into 2cm-thick chips. Put the chips on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, scatter over 1 tsp barbecue seasoning and toss to coat. Roast for 23-25 mins until golden and tender.

Make slaw: Meanwhile, shred the carrot using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline. Combine 1 tbs vegan mayonnaise (see Make it yours) and 3 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the carrot and cabbage and toss to combine.

Cook patties: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Scatter 1 tsp barbecue seasoning over the plant-based patties and turn to coat. Cook the patties for 4-5 mins each side until browned. Remove the pan from the heat.
Toast bread rolls: While the patties are cooking, cut the bread rolls in half. Put the rolls on an oven tray, cut-side up, and bake for 5-6 mins until lightly toasted.
Serve up: Divide the roll bases among plates and layer with the patties, barbecue sauce, slaw and chips. Sandwich with the tops and serve with the remaining slaw and remaining chips. Enjoy!
Make it yours: If you aren't following a vegan diet, use whatever mayonnaise you have on hand.
